# A draft invoice for customer C-TWICE, in a book already holding two
# customers with that ID.
#
# `customer_id:` is the only thing saying whose invoice it is, and two
# customers answer to it.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_id_two_records_have_is_refused.py.
invoice "INV-TWICE"
	customer_id: "C-TWICE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
